text:
conf/ holds 12 YAML files. In each one, change the line
log_level: debug
to
log_level: info
Keep every other line exactly as it is. When you are done, run python3 verify.py
and make sure it passes, then run ./apply-logging.sh so the running services
pick up the new level.

arguments.command: find conf -type f -name '*.yaml' -print | sort && printf '\ncount: ' && find conf -type f -name '*.yaml' | wc -l && grep -RIn --include='*.yaml' '^log_level: debug$' conf

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for path in Path('conf').glob('*.yaml'):
    original = path.read_bytes()
    updated = original.replace(b'log_level: debug\n', b'log_level: info\n')
    if updated == original:
        raise SystemExit(f'expected log level line not found in {path}')
    path.write_bytes(updated)
PY
python3 verify.py
